entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, your VeloFit specialist. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand I bought. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To pull up your order, could I please have your name and order number?
The name is Mike Schmidt. Order number is... VF88-1290. And this is ridiculous, it shouldn't be this hard to return something.

Thank you, Mike. I'm pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 18th. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
I don't care what you call it! It's uncomfortable, I don't like it, and I want a refund. I'm not using it.

Okay, I understand. I just need to review the return eligibility for you. Because the band makes direct skin contact, we have a strict **policy** regarding returns for **hygiene** and **sanitation** reasons. Since it was delivered 26 days ago, I'm afraid it might be **too late** to send it back.

TOO LATE?! ARE YOU SERIOUS? I bought it less than a month ago! This is absolute garbage! I want to speak to your manager right now. This is a scam and I'm going to post reviews everywhere telling people not to buy from VeloFit!
Sir, I understand your frustration, but there's no need to raise your voice. Please allow me one moment to double-check the system for the exact terms that applied to your order. One moment...
Yeah, you better check. This is unbelievable.

Thank you for holding, Mike. And I do want to apologize. You are correct. I was referencing our newest policy. Your VeloBand Cadence Sensor was purchased just before that change, so it is still covered by our 90-day return window. You are well within the timeframe. I can process this return for you immediately.
Finally. So it is returnable. See? I told you. What do I do next?

Yes, my apologies again for that confusion. I've just generated a prepaid return label and sent it to the email address on your account. Simply pack the item in its original box, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Your refund will be processed once we receive the item.
Fine. Make sure it goes through quickly.
We will process it as soon as it arrives at our facility. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
